QuestInfo.0: It's time for Edea to unleash her ultimate magic. Don't let any enemies escape the blast zone.
QuestInfo.1: Edea is about to unleash her ultimate magic. Don't let any enemies escape the blast zone.\r\n#r(Since this is a battlefield quest, you must forfeit the quest and restart if you fail.)#k
